newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-RAPID CENTURY FOR JULIAN IN AUSTRALIA WIN.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-RAPID CENTURY FOR JULIAN IN AUSTRALIA WIN.

text.p: All-rounder Brendon Julian, unable to command a place in Australia's test side, hammered a 79-ball century as the visitors beat England's Minor Counties by nine runs on Tuesday.
Julian's second 50 came from only 15 deliveries, including six sixes from 10 balls, as he hit 106 in Australia's 50-over total of 290 for seven.
Altogether the left-arm seamer who bats right-handed hit eight sixes and nine fours.

Minor Counties captain Ian Cockbain, formerly of Lancashire, made 82 in the reply of 281 for nine, but a lot of his runs came against part-time bowlers and there was never any threat of a shock defeat for the tourists.

In a team containing only five of the test line-up, Australia's second highest scorer, with 35 not out, was Matthew Elliott, normally an opener but batting at number eight. Replacement wicketkeeper Darren Berry made 34 in his first match since joining the squad.
Steve Waugh captained the team but did not bat or bowl because of a swollen hand suffered while making two hundreds in the third Test at Old Trafford.
